title.en: Deposit Insurance (Exemption from Scheme Membership) (No. 2) Notification 2008

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Deposit Insurance (Exemption from Scheme Membership) (No. 2) Notification 2008 and shall come into operation on 31st December 2008.

2.—(1) The Authority hereby exempts the American Express Bank Ltd., Singapore Branch from the requirement under section 5(1) of the Act to be a member of the Deposit Insurance Scheme.
(2) The exemption under sub-paragraph (1) is subject to such conditions and restrictions as the Authority may specify in writing to the American Express Bank Ltd., Singapore Branch under section 6(5) or (6) of the Act.
